summary: Consolidate contractor seat pool and migrate billing for StratoForms survey platform
license_details: Requested seats: 200 contractor tokens (floating) + 20 admin seats
Term: 12 months preferred, option for month-to-month for contractor pool
Discount request: 15% multi-year ADM discount if commit annual
description:
Issue summary:
Request to centralize and standardize provisioning for temporary contractor seats currently purchased ad-hoc by multiple eng teams on StratoForms. Goal is to move contractor token billing onto central procurement, negotiate multi-year discount, and enable SCIM provisioning for automatic seat assignment and reclaiming.

Impact:
- Currently ~120 contractor tokens are scattered across 4 team cards; no central ownership, billing fragmentation, and manual deprovisioning leads to unused paid seats.
- Risk of overspend and missing SSO/SCIM binding for audits.

Business justification:
- Standardize vendor contract and billing to procurement to reduce duplicate spend and enable corporate discounts.
- Improve security posture by enabling SCIM to reclaim contractor access after offboarding.

Steps requested:
1) Get vendor quote for 200 floating contractor tokens + 20 admin seats with annual and monthly terms.
2) Negotiate a 15% discount for 12-month commit or 10% for Q2 commit.
3) Issue PO from cost center ENG-OPS-4200 and consolidate existing team subscriptions into one corporate seat pool.
4) Enable SSO (Okta) + SCIM mapping; create an org group for contractors and define reclaim policy (30 days idle).
5) Set renewal date to align with 2027-03-01 to simplify renewals.

Vendor contact:
- Name: Priya Nambiar, Account Rep (StratoForms)
- Email: priya.n@stratoforms.com

Attachments: vendor quote requested (awaiting).

investigation_notes: Reviewed current subscriptions and found 4 active corporate cards and 9 one-off invoices. No single owner for contractor pool.
Vendor supports SCIM and Okta SAML SSO; will require org-level admin seat to enable provisioning endpoints.
Legal flagged standard Term Sheet clause on data export; vendor agreed to add data export SLA for enterprise plan (added to negotiation notes).

Cost comparison: Annual consolidated quote (vendor 12% discount) reduces effective spend by ~8% vs current extrapolated year spend across teams when accounting for admin seats and reclaiming idle tokens.
Risks: If vendor refuses PO-based billing switch, teams will need manual refunds and migration; this increases timeline by 4-6 weeks.
